guestBanner.title: Try for free
guestBanner.text: No registration — 1 trial article. After signing up — free plan forever: 5 AI consultations every month.

doctorBanner.title: 3 months free for new doctors
doctorBanner.text: After registration — Doctor Start-level capabilities free for 3 months. The account then moves to Lite at $9/month until you choose another plan.

patientFooter: 💡 The free plan is forever. Paid features activate immediately after payment, cancel anytime.
doctorFooter: 💡 The platform takes no percentage of your consultations on any plan — the patient's payment goes to the doctor in full. Choose a plan by the size of your practice, not to reduce a commission.
clinicFooter: 💡 The Enterprise plan includes a dedicated manager and custom configuration tailored to your clinic. Contact us to discuss.
